text:
maria: FYI moving partner/proxy keys into the segmented-quota proxy. Need decisions on override semantics (temporary top-ups vs permanent tier changes) so we can spec console + API.

jiang: +1. Also: must keep a clear audit chain for overrides. Partners and internal services need different trust levels.

sam: We currently have per-org overrides; per-key is straightforward in enforcement but the UI + audit is the heavy lift.

lexi: Telemetry note: tag requests that consumed override capacity so billing/SLO dashboards can filter those separately.

maria: Duration granularity? partners typically ask for 1h or 24h top-ups. Internal ops sometimes want minutes.

amanda: For internal services we need an "approver" field and service-category label so we can query who approved and why.

jiang: Approver can be an email string. We'll need to add approver + reason to the override schema.

sam: Implementation idea: reuse overrides table but add key_id FK and scope field. Minimal object: {key_id, amount, window, expires_at, approver, reason, created_by}.

maria: Console UX: Keys page -> add 'Temporary top-up' button. Modal: amount, duration dropdown, approver, reason. Show audit link after creation.

lexi: Also show a per-key history row (expandable). Allow inline 'revoke' if override hasn't been consumed.

amanda: RBAC: only users with 'key-admin' or 'partner-ops' can create/revoke. Auto-approve for keys matching internal/* prefix.

sam: Runtime enforcement: proxy attaches override metadata to request context. Enforcement reads effective_quota = base_quota + sum(active_overrides).

maria: Edge cases: overlapping overrides — sum them. If revoked retroactively, tokens already consumed remain billed/consumed.

jiang: Telemetry metrics to emit: 'quota.override.used' with tags {key_id, override_id, approver, reason} and 'quota.effective' per request.

lexi: Can we create an alert when an override is >80% consumed before expiry? That would help ops.

sam: Yes - that can be an alert rule in Console based on the metric (window 5m).

maria: Partners want programmatic top-ups. API shape? We need partner->request flow to avoid abuse.

amanda: Security: require mTLS + signed request for partner-initiated topups. For > threshold amounts require human approval.

jiang: Prefer request workflow: partner creates request (pending), humans approve, system applies override and webhook to partner on success/failure.

maria: Example admin API for internal use:
```
POST /internal/keys/{key_id}/overrides
{
  "amount": 500000,
  "duration_minutes": 120,
  "approver": "amanda@redwood.ai",
  "reason": "ETL backfill"
}
```

quota-bot: Override 2345 created for key key_abcxyz amount=500000 duration=120m approver=amanda@redwood.ai (created_by=maria)

sam: We should also show 'used_from_override' on the realtime usage graph and surface per-override consumption in the history pane.

lexi: UX: visually mark overrides as 'temporary' with countdown and distinct color.

maria: Rollout plan: gate behind feature-flag 'per_key_overrides_v1'. Start with internal keys only for 2 weeks, then enable partner beta.

jiang: Migration: map existing per-org overrides to synthetic per-key overrides for keys under that org during the flip.

amanda: Audit: append-only events stored in ledger table + CSV export for compliance reviews.

sam: Testing: unit tests for enforcement math, e2e simulating bursts to ensure fallback to org quota when per-key exhausted.

maria: Ops playbook: to revoke a runaway override use Console revoke -> proxy must pick up revoke immediately by invalidating cache.

lexi: Cache TTL implication: ensure revoke propagated within ~5s. Use invalidation message via our fast invalidation queue.

maria: Also consider an emergency global softcap override that operators can apply to stop cost storms.

jiang: One more: rate-limit partner override requests. Default 1 request per 10m per partner; can raise for trusted partners.

amanda: +1 on rate limit. For internal keys we allow higher rate.

maria: OK I'll open the PR with schema changes, console mocks, and an infra ticket for cache invalidation hook. I'll add telemetry instrumentation plan.

sam: I'll own enforcement + tests.

lexi: I'll design the modal and history UX.

amanda: I'll draft RBAC and approval rules.

maria: I'll also schedule a short canary with partner-ops.

sam: thanks everyone.

lexi: :thumbsup:

quota-bot: Thread closed: feature-flag per_key_overrides_v1 scheduled for canary on 1709539200
